# FLICK guest header

`FUCK_API.h` is the guest header of [FLICK](https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/181603) by Fuzzlesz. It is third-party code and **not** covered by the MIT license of this repository.

- Source: https://github.com/Fuzzlesz/FUCK_API at commit `bc5280921bee6d8585fe18e14302a8bd9b074692` (API v7, FLICK 1.7.0 or newer), unmodified
- License: GNU General Public License v3.0, see [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md) in this folder. FLICK itself is GPL-3.0-or-later with a Modding Exception and a GPL-3.0 Linking Exception, see `EXCEPTIONS.md` in the FLICK repository.

The header contains inline code that is compiled into `SpellHotbar2.dll`. Because of that the built plugin is distributed under the GPL-3.0-or-later, see the License section of the README in the repository root.
